text:
sam (backend): Heads up folks, I'm planning to move from NYC -> Portland the week of Sept 12. What changes should I expect for WFH stipend, state taxes, and any relocation help? Also wondering if Oregon payroll registration for Redwood is needed if a few folks move there.
tara (People Ops): Congrats on the move! :party_popper: High-level checklist: 1) Submit Move Notice (intranet) so Payroll & Benefits get notified. 2) Update your address in Self-Serve. 3) File a prorated WFH expense for September. 4) Talk to your manager about relocation support eligibility (usually for Sr+ or critical hires).

If you want I can DM the Move Checklist and link to our relocation policy.
sam (backend): Thanks. I'm on the $120/mo WFH stipend. Moving on Sept 14 so does that mean 14/30 days of stipend? And any impact on my 401k payroll deferrals?
tara (People Ops): Yes, prorate by days in old state. Example (Sept 14 move): you were in NY for 13 days, so stipend = round(120 * 13 / 30, 2). 401k elections remain the same; deferrals continue unless you change them.
owen (Legal): Quick legal point: Oregon has a state income tax, so moving there will switch your withholding to OR. If we suddenly get multiple employees in OR we may need to register for payroll withholding and unemployment insurance there  that could create a tax/registration obligation. For a single employee it's usually just withholding changes, but Finance will flag if we hit registration thresholds.
beth (Payroll): Timeline: update address by payroll cutoff (10 business days before move) to change withholdings for the next pay run. If we miss the cutoff we'll do a reconciliation on the following payroll. Also, for HSA/FSA pretax accounts, moving states can affect eligibility rules  notify Benefits if you have HSA to confirm plan compatibility.
sam (backend): And benefits like network coverage? I use our primary medical plan through BCBS NY. Will I be auto-switched?
tara (People Ops): Most plans let you stay enrolled but network access can vary. Benefits will reach out if your specific plan/network is unavailable in OR; we may offer alternate in-state network or allow mid-year change if required. Expect a Benefits confirmation within 7 business days after address change.
sam (backend): Good to know. Manager sign-off needed for relocation cover?
tara (People Ops): Yes, relocation reimbursements or lump-sum moves require manager approval and People Ops sign-off. Policy highlights: - Relocation cash grants: reserved for certain hires/levels. - Expense reimbursement: must include receipts and be submitted within 60 days.
own (Legal): Couple extra notes: 1) City taxes (NYC) end when you leave  you'll need to file final NY local tax if applicable. 2) If you're temporarily remote (short-term cross-state) we treat permanent moves differently than temporary work-from-other-state arrangements; please indicate if this is permanent.
beth (Payroll): Also, if you have stock option withholding elections tied to payroll, state tax differences may affect net payout on exercises. Reach out to Payroll for simulations.
sam (backend): One more  equipment. Can I ship desk and monitor to OR and get reimbursed?
tara (People Ops): Equipment moves are usually handled as relocation expense if approved. Alternatively, we can arrange IT to issue new kit and arrange pickup. Put the request in the Move Notice form so IT and Ops see it.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit Move Notice: https://intranet.redwood/company/move-notice. Payroll cutoff for Sep moves: 2026-08-31. To cancel queued address change run `/payroll cancel-address` within 72h.
sam (backend): Awesome, I'll submit the form today and loop my manager. Thank you all! :raised_hands:
